643-1809-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-1809-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2317-4826-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
2317-4826-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2137-4642-4742.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-4742.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

1278-3327-4508-8095.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
1278-3327-4508-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1278-3327-4508-8095.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat.

687-2034-8138.description:
Cast Grishnákh by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Grishnákh enters, it creates a creature token with mutiple counters on it, including a vigilance counter due to Tayam, and, if possible, allows you to gain control of a creature with lesser power than that token's power until end of turn.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing two vigilance counters and one additional counter from creatures you control.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Grishnákh and one additional creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Grishnákh from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2034-8138.notes: This order of operations and the additional {3} starting mana is necessary because you must activate mana abilities like Ashnod's Altar's before paying the counter removal cost.

4125-4826-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4125-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Shipwreck Dowser and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Shipwreck Dowser and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
4125-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Shipwreck Dowser and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

5147-6982--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When that creature enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

728-967-3809-6441-7087.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3020-6495-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
3020-6495-6701.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3020-6495-6701.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-3991-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

5571-6331-8095--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5571-6331-8095--6.description:
Use Stiltzkin to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1086-1981-2415-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1086-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with Mana Cost Equal to {0}

3182-3676-5751-7824--1.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
3182-3676-5751-7824--1.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your graveyard for its retrace cost by discarding a land card.
Tangleroot and Turntimber Sower trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Turntimber Sower trigger, creating two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G}, sacrificing the {0} cost creature and sacrificing the two Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

6752-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6752-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1367-7417-7438.description:
If Sanar isn't prepared, activate Skycoach Waypoint's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, causing Sanar to become prepared.
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.
1367-7417-7438.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration. If Sanar is prepared to start, you can save {3} the first iteration.

1170-1329-4708-4742.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2034-3773-6972--112.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2034-3773-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3174-5434-5555-6797.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
3174-5434-5555-6797.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3528-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
392-3528-3976.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding Rise of the Eldrazi.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{R}{B}, noting Rise of the Eldrazi and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the 3/3 creature that has Rise of the Eldrazi noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Rise of the Eldrazi without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Rise of the Eldrazi copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.
392-3528-3976.notes: The discard outlet is provided as a method of getting Rise of the Eldrazi into your graveyard, as it does not go to the graveyard after resolution. You can substitute any other method for this, including using mill or other techniques.

2034-2366-3678-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2464-4944-5137.notablePrerequisites:
Morphling does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has one or two lore counters on it.
2464-4944-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling's first ability by paying {U}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Morphling ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

1738-2037.notablePrerequisites:
Minsc & Boo has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1738-2037.description:
Activate Minsc & Boo's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, sacrificing Serra Avatar and dealing damage equal to Serra Avatar's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1621-4344-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield.
Wispweaver Angel and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.

3015-4050-4215.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing God-Eternal Rhonas, adding one mana of any color.
God-Eternal Rhonas dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the God-Eternal Rhonas trigger, putting it into your library third from the top.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for God-Eternal Rhonas, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
God-Eternal Rhonas enters the battlefield, doubling the power of each other creature you control and giving them vigilance until end of turn.
Repeat.
